sections.summary: School and work cultures must allow time and space for people to pilot-test vocational interests, with a sustainable solution for those facing barriers.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: For many, this space has to be created for them.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: We must build school and work cultures that allow time, mental and physical space for our people to pilot-test their growing vocational interests in the same field or different ones.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: For those who face social and economic barriers to access these resources, we will need to work towards a sustainable solution.

sections.label: Workforce and creative thinking
sections.summary: Building a workforce that creates jobs requires complementing critical thinking training with creative thinking, shifting PET and CET approaches.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: Together with our people, we can build a workforce that not only takes up jobs in the new economy, but also creates jobs in economies yet to exist.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: We can and should be intentional to complement training critical thinking skills with creative thinking ones.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong (West Coast)
sentences.text: These will have broad implications on not just the "what" of education and training, but the "how" of doing so, requiring intentional shifts in our PET and CET approaches.

sections.label: Temasek grew in relevance
sections.summary: Temasek grew in relevance at the end of the 13th century.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Temasek grew in relevance at the end of the 13th century.

sections.label: Temasek thrived and prospered
sections.summary: Temasek's open and connected nature and competitive edge let it thrive and prosper within 50 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Temasek's open and connected nature, coupled with its competitive edge, allowed it to thrive and prosper within a short span of 50 years.

sections.label: Temasek ceded to Melaka
sections.summary: Temasek was ceded to Melaka for an annual payment of gold and swapped away with no control over its destiny.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Eventually, Temasek was ceded to Melaka in exchange for an annual payment of gold and was swapped away like a common chattel, with no control over its own destiny.

sections.label: Singapore as global node
sections.summary: Singapore must find new ways to be a vital node with deep interconnections worldwide, agreeing with Deputy Prime Minister Heng Swee Keat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Singapore's Future must be relevant to the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: I agree with Deputy Prime Minister Heng Swee Keat that Singapore needs to find new ways to be a vital node, with rich and deep interconnections with the rest of the world.

sections.label: SmartLaw AI legal tool
sections.summary: SmartLaw developed an AI tool using natural language self-learning algorithms to sift relevant references and judgments quickly, in a growing legal market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: SmartLaw, a home-grown company, has developed an AI tool that leverages powerful natural language self-learning algorithms, which can sift the most relevant references and judgments, from an immense number of documents, within split seconds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: According to market estimates, the APAC legal industry is a $100 plus billion market that is growing at 5% CAGR and Singapore legal industry is about $2 plus billion.

sections.label: Smallest nanosatellite with ion thruster
sections.summary: They developed the world's smallest nanosatellite platform with a fully functional Hall-Effect thruster, to be deployed from a SpaceX Falcon 9 in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Together, they developed the world's smallest nanosatellite platform that is equipped with a fully functional Hall-Effect thruster or better known as an Ion thruster, with record breaking operational power.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: This satellite will be deployed out of a SpaceX Falcon 9 in second quarter of 2021.

sections.label: Google quantum computer milestone
sections.summary: Last year, Google's quantum computer solved a 10,000-year problem in mere seconds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Just last year, Google's quantum computer achieved a significant milestone when it solved a 10,000-year problem in just mere seconds.

sections.label: Resolute test development partners
sections.summary: The Resolute test for diagnostics was developed with Tan Tock Seng Hospital, Diagnostic Development Hub and A-Star.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: For diagnostics, we developed the Resolute test with Tan Tock Seng Hospital, Diagnostic Development (DxD) Hub and A-Star.

sections.label: Essence of being Singaporean
sections.summary: No empire or state lasts forever, so Singapore must distil the essence of being Singaporean, built on trust, respect, plurality and shared layers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: No empire, nation state or city state existed in the same form forever and the important factor is distilling the essence of being Singaporean, such that the very core of who we are, does not wane and flow with the tides of time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Deep trust and mutual respect will need to form the basis of the relationship between fellow Singaporeans, earned through the help and sacrifices that we give one another.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: We need to maintain a profound respect for plurality in Singapore and find shared layers above this diversity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: As a nation, we were never endowed with the best cards, but we never used it as an excuse from what needs to be done.

sections.label: PM Lee on Jewel, Changi, SIA
sections.summary: Prime Minister Lee's statement that Jewel, Changi and SIA will shine, thrive and fly again struck a deep chord.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Prime Minister Lee's statement struck a very deep chord in me, "Jewel will shine again, Changi will thrive again and SIA will be a great way to fly once more.

sections.label: Global COVID-19 infections and deaths
sections.summary: Globally, over 25 million people have been infected and an estimated 860,000 have died in eight months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Globally, more than 25 million people have been infected and an estimated 860,000 people have died in just eight months.

sections.label: Government $100 billion COVID-19 support
sections.summary: The Government committed $100 billion in six months, drawing on reserves, and DPM Heng extended support to firms and workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Government has committed $100 billion in the last six months, drawing on our reserves to cushion the economic and social impact of COVID-19 on our people.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Two weeks ago, Deputy Prime Minister Heng further extended support to firms and workers.

sections.label: COVID-19 blow to construction sector
sections.summary: COVID-19 has dealt the construction sector a very heavy blow.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: COVID-19 has dealt the construction sector a very heavy blow.

sections.label: COVID-19 unequal effects and questions
sections.summary: COVID-19's unequal effects on jobs and workers have raised difficult questions about divides, job value, assistance and biases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: COVID-19's unequal effects on jobs and workers have thrown up difficult questions for all of us, as it has for many societies around the world: an increasing socio-economic divide between those who have more and those who have less; a re-evaluation of the value of different jobs and how much essential workers are paid; the kinds of financial assistance that might be needed to mitigate income and job losses in the medium to longer term; and deep-rooted assumptions and biases and how we interact with one another online and offline.

sections.label: Social safety nets and support ideas
sections.summary: The Government enhanced social safety nets and will study ideas like minimum wage or unemployment insurance while keeping the system fair and sustainable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As the Prime Minister and Deputy Prime Minister have explained, the Government has enhanced social safety nets significantly as our economy matures, introduced wage support for lower income workers, and supplemented retirement and healthcare support for seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: With deeper economic uncertainty in the years ahead and an ageing society, we will commit to do more to help our people.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: There have been different suggestions on how to do this, including introducing a minimum wage or unemployment insurance, in addition to existing approaches we have adopted, such as the Progressive Wage Model, Workfare and increased support for lifelong learning and job matching.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will study all these ideas seriously while ensuring that our overall system remains fair and sustainable for generations to come.

sections.label: Coordinated help for vulnerable families
sections.summary: The passage calls for coordinated, personal help across social service agencies, community and self-help groups, charities, religious and Government agencies to unlock constraints on individuals and families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: What we need is not just many helping hands but hands that help in a more coordinated and personal way to unlock specific shackles that constrain these individuals and families from progressing in their lives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We must set aside organisational differences and better coordinate across social service agencies, community and self-help groups, charities, religious organisations and Government agencies.

sections.label: Engaging community and constructive dialogue
sections.summary: Members spoke on engaging all community segments and building consensus, and the Emerging Stronger Conversations were launched to encourage constructive dialogue, especially online.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Ms Tin Pei Ling, Mr Darryl David and Ms Nadia Samdin spoke about the need to engage all segments of the community to tackle issues together and build consensus across different generations and backgrounds. and Minister of State Tan Kiat How and Parliamentary Secretary Rahayu Mahzam spoke about how we should encourage such constructive dialogue, especially online.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: That is one reason why we launched the Emerging Stronger Conversations.

sections.label: SG Cares Community Networks
sections.summary: SG Cares Community Networks were formed within each town, bringing public officers together with social service professionals, local partners and grassroots organisations to support vulnerable households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In the social sector, for instance, we formed SG Cares Community Networks within each town, bringing together public officers from different Government agencies who work together with the social service professionals, local community partners and grassroots organisations, to befriend and support more vulnerable households.

sections.label: City in nature, One Million Trees
sections.summary: Singapore will be transformed into a city in nature and One Million Trees will be planted together with Singaporeans in the coming years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In the coming years, we will transform Singapore into a city nature, plant One Million Trees together with Singaporeans.

sections.label: Singapore Together Action Networks
sections.summary: Everyone is needed to reduce energy use, reduce waste and care for the environment, and Singapore Together Action Networks were launched to translate conversations into actions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We need everyone to be part of this effort to reduce the energy we use, reduce the waste we produce and care collectively for our environment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We launched the Singapore Together Action Networks to help translate our conversations into real actions.

sections.label: Beyond COVID-19 Taskforce
sections.summary: Since June, a new Action Network, the Beyond COVID-19 Taskforce for the social sector, has been identified.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Since June, we have also identified a new Action Network – the Beyond COVID-19 Taskforce for our social sector.

sections.label: Alliances for Action
sections.summary: Industry-led coalitions called Alliances for Action were set up to develop and test new growth ideas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In the economic domain too, we have set up the Alliances for Action, which are industry-led coalitions aimed at quickly developing and testing new ideas for growth.

sections.label: Supply Chain Digitalisation Alliance
sections.summary: The Alliance for Action on Supply Chain Digitalisation held seven workshops involving close to 50 organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Alliance for Action on Supply Chain Digitalisation aims to achieve this.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Alliance has organised seven workshops to engage players across the supply chain, involving close to 50 organisations from MNCs to SMEs and many government agencies.

sections.label: Sustainable growth and worker retraining
sections.summary: COVID-19 showed growth must be sustainable and resilient, and workers should be retrained and redeployed instead of released.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: COVID-19 has shown us that our economic growth needs to be more sustainable and more resilient to shocks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We will help you prepare for the future, but we need you to do the same for your workers – to retrain and redeploy them instead of letting them go, groom and develop them, and bring them along your journey.

sections.label: Starting from a position of strength
sections.summary: Singaporeans are concerned about the unknown future, but the country starts from strength in experience, reserves and unity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We do not know what the future holds ahead of us and Singaporeans are understandably concerned.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: But we are starting from a position of strength – learning from our past experiences in fighting disease outbreaks, drawing on fiscal reserves that we have built up over decades and generations and, most importantly, standing united in the face of challenges and adversity.

sections.label: Fighting the virus as one country
sections.summary: The country will fight and win against the virus, and 74 Members spoke in support of the Motion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: As one country, we will fight this virus and win.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: We will fight with our hearts, our minds and our souls, protecting this island that we call Our Home." Mr Speaker, Sir, over these past five days, 74 Members have spoken in support of the Motion including the Prime Minister.

sections.label: Crisis of a generation
sections.summary: Members said the House is tackling a crisis of the generation at an inflection point in history.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: As many of the Members of this House had put forth, we are tackling a crisis of the generation and we are at an inflection point in our history.

sections.label: Sectors with slower rebound
sections.summary: Aviation, aerospace, marine and offshore, and tourism will take a longer time to rebound.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Some sectors such as aviation, aerospace, marine and offshore, and tourism, will take a longer time to rebound.

sections.label: SkillsFuture support for older workers
sections.summary: SkillsFuture, with added support for older workers to re-skill and upskill and a focus on skills over qualifications, is a step in the right direction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: SkillsFuture, especially the additional support for older workers to re-skill, upskill and the focus on skills over people's qualifications at a workplace is a step in the right direction for our society.

sections.label: Skills maps and job redesign
sections.summary: Strategies for industries to transform and diversify need stronger linkage through skills maps, job redesign, job retraining and re-scaling of workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: As we review and formulate strategies for industries to transform and diversify, we will need to create an even stronger linkage in the form of skills maps, job redesign, job retraining and re-scaling of our workers to take on these jobs.

sections.label: Foreign manpower and Singaporean Core
sections.summary: The speaker cites competition from foreign manpower and unfair employment practices, welcomes MOM and MAS scrutiny, and urges employers to keep Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Intense competition from the influx of foreign manpower and incidence of unfair employment practices by employers who display a clear preference for foreigners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I am heartened by Minister Josephine Teo's announcement that MOM is reviewing and taking a close scrutiny of companies whose Singaporean Core has been weakening and that Minister Ong Ye Kung has shared that the Monetary Authority of Singapore will ensure fair hiring opportunities while grooming Singaporeans as leaders and specialists in the financial sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: In these uncertain times, it is ever more important for all employers to play their part in building up their Singaporean Core and in circumstances where retrenchment is unavoidable and is the final option and employers have to choose between a foreigner and a Singaporean.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I strongly urge the employers to lean towards keeping the Singaporean.

sections.label: Fewer jobs as support eases
sections.summary: As some jobs support measures ease in the months ahead, there will be fewer job opportunities and perhaps more retrenchments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: As some of the jobs support measures will ease in in the months ahead, there will be fewer job opportunities and, perhaps, even more retrenchments.

sections.label: Uplifting low-wage workers
sections.summary: Uplifting low-wage workers requires ensuring they acquire skills to progress, plus the Progressive Wage Model, Workfare Income Supplement and National Wages Council recommendations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: To continue to uplift our low-wage workers, we will need to ensure they acquire the skills to progress, not to forget the Triple Uplift formula of the Progressive Wage Model plus Workfare Income Supplement and, of course, the National Wages Council recommendations.

sections.label: Unemployment insurance as another job
sections.summary: The Prime Minister says the best unemployment insurance is the assurance of another job.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: As mentioned Prime Minister, the best unemployment insurance is, in fact, the assurance of another job.

sections.label: Social mobility and safety nets
sections.summary: The speaker looks forward to government investment in training and opportunities, and says social safety nets must be strengthened and inequality kept in check.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: To facilitate social mobility, I look forward to the Government's continuous investment in our people with the necessary training and opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: As we deal with the major changes in the economy and labour market, it is important to strengthen our social safety nets and keep inequality in check.

sections.label: Levelling starting blocks and education
sections.summary: The speaker says uneven starting blocks must be levelled, opportunities provided at every stage of life, and the education system kept a social enabler.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: We must strive as much as possible to level uneven starting blocks and to provide opportunities at every stage of life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: It is also our hope that our education system will always remain a social enabler so that everyone, especially those who may have started with less, can have the hope and confidence that in Singapore, they have equal access to opportunities to do well, achieve their aspirations and find happiness.

sections.label: Singaporeans' new aspirations and expectations
sections.summary: Mdm President shared that Singaporeans have new aspirations and expectations, including more diverse voices and stronger checks and balances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Last, but not least, Mdm President shared that Singaporeans have new aspirations and expectations, including a desire for more diverse voices to be heard, and stronger checks and balances.

sections.label: Recognising the Leader of the Opposition
sections.summary: Members in this House have applauded the Government for recognising the Leader of the Opposition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Members in this House have also applauded the Government for recognising the Leader of the Opposition.

sections.label: Uniting for a better society
sections.summary: The speaker urges all to unite to build a liveable and sustainable society founded on mutual trust with opportunities for all.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: We must unite so that we can leave behind a better society for children and their children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: I urge all of us to come together to build a liveable and sustainable society and country founded on mutual trust with opportunities for all.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Listen well, look out for one another, stay strong and communicate with grace and empathy.
